summary: Prior simulated-private replay of the Cianjur event.
initial_assessment: Public proximity was potential only. The private replay later confirmed primary loss and stale backup capacity.
lesson: Do not declare a backup feasible from nominal capacity. Recheck current supplier capacity and shared upstream dependencies before promising customer recovery.

initial_assessment: The public port disruption mattered only because explicit private transport lanes used CNYTN.
lesson: Route dependence is the business dependency. Port proximity to a factory is not enough. Check the actual lane and customer due date.

summary: Prior simulated-private Vietnam to U.S. tariff policy review.
initial_assessment: Origin and destination matched the policy, but product-level duty still required classification and exemption review.
lesson: Never multiply a headline tariff rate across every SKU. Resolve classification and exemptions first; then compare landed-cost recovery options.
